notes: Born Bradford, Essex County, MA, 1811. Father Eliphalet Boynton; mother Susan Nichols. Sister Olive Boynton Hale (nephew Alma Helaman Hale of Grantsville, UT). First wife Susan Lowell. Excommunicated 1837. Bradford MA is Essex County - overlaps geographically with some early New England Mormon families. Sister's marriage into Hale family worth noting but no direct apostle link found. No connections to main cluster.
